physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the principles of Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-02.material: Pasi pe rail isina friction (pakukwirira $0$), vertical circular loop ine radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$ yakabatanidzwa. Chinhu chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinosiiwa chimire panharaunda yerail kuti chitenderere loop kamwe. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, minimum starting height $h_{min}$ (kubva pasi) kuti chipfuure musoro weloop pasina kubuda murail, uye normal force $15\,\mathrm{m}$ inoshandiswa nerail pachinhu kumusoro kwe loop kana starting height iri $N$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Pasi pe rail isina friction (pakukwirira $0$), vertical circular loop ine radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$ yakabatanidzwa. Chinhu chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinosiiwa chimire panharaunda yerail kuti chitenderere loop kamwe. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, minimum starting height $h_{min}$ (kubva pasi) kuti chipfuure musoro weloop pasina kubuda murail, uye normal force $15\,\mathrm{m}$ inoshandiswa nerail pachinhu kumusoro kwe loop kana starting height iri $N$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Mamiriro eminimum $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Kubva pakuchengetedzwa kwesimba $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$ kunowanikwa $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Kana $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Pa $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Kushandisa kukwirira $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ chete kunoreva kukanganwa kinetic energy (nhema ①), $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ kunoreva kusatarisa gravity (nhema ②), $90\,\mathrm{N}$ ndiko kukanganisa chiratidzo chokuwedzera gravity (nhema ③).
